items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: I was playing with Sidney Desveen at the time. And we played the boat for that summer.

ctx.x: I left there on the Steema Capitol. I was playing with Sidney Desveen at the time. And we played the boat for that summer. Went all the way up the river. All the way to St. Paul, yes. So I left the unit in St. Paul because I got pretty sick. And I started going back to New Orleans where I just came here to Chicago since my closest relatives was here. And I've been here ever since. Of course I have been tempted to go back several times during that period but I never did get back.
Tell me a little more about Manuel Perez when you heard his band. Where was it? Economy Hall?

items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: As a matter of fact we worked together in Sidney Dancefein's band and his name was, we used to call him Wiggles.

ctx.x: That's right, and my mother used to save the coupons from it. Oh yeah. But they used to have coupons with it, you know, along with the octagon soap and all that. And they used to have a mixture wherein they'd mix it up together and scrub the steps and naturally get through and then wash the sidewalks with the brick. And by the time the steps was dry and the red brick was dry it was just like this red rug sitting on the floor. Of course it wouldn't last very long depending on the time of the year it was and how…
